data.one_liner: A floating action button that animates its size when scrolling down.
data.what_it_does: Provides a scrolling-aware floating action button that changes size and hides its text when scrolling down, and restores itself when returning to the top of a scrollable view. It supports custom icons, animation durations, curves, and long-press actions.
use_when: You want a floating action button that collapses or shrinks when users scroll down a ListView or GridView
You want to save screen space while scrolling through long lists
avoid_when: You are not using a scrollable widget with a ScrollController
You require non-Material design floating action components
strengths: Easy to integrate with existing ScrollControllers
Supports customizable animation duration, curves, and limits
Includes features like ripple effects, long-press support, and icon animation
weaknesses: Limited to floating action button functionality
data.minimal_example:
ScrollingFabAnimated(
  icon: Icon(Icons.add, color: Colors.white),
  text: Text('Add', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 16.0)),
  onPress: (){},
  scrollController: _scrollController,
  animateIcon: true,
  inverted: false,
  radius: 10.0,
)
